ad_intro: Solex Energy is the best-performing business in this Day-1 cohort on paper. FY26 revenue Rs.1,618 crore, up 144.3%. Q4 FY26 alone Rs.885.53 crore, up 247.6%. PAT Rs.98.3 crore, up 132.7%. An order book above Rs.4,000 crore as of 31 Mar 2026, 200+ EPC projects executed, ALMM-certified TOPCon lines, and FY27 guidance of Rs.2,600 crore. Listed on NSE as SOLEX. On 14 Sep 2026 the marketing layer sitting on top of that business is running an estimated 33 Meta creatives against a dead domain, a homepage whose achievement counters display 0, and an Instagram feed whose most recent posts are 80s-nostalgia memes.
ad_intelligence: ~33 active Meta ads (Day-1 estimate, 14 Sep 2026) at an estimated Rs.8-20 L/month. Verify in Meta Ad Library India.

Lead Form. The Day-1 domain solexenergy.com does not resolve - SSL handshake failure on both bare and www hosts. The live site is solex.in, so the Google Ads Transparency link in the record tracks nothing.

Strong B2B kit: six named module series (Tapi RC, Tapi R, Tapi Trans, Tapi Series, Tapi Black, Ganga) with efficiency, cell count and warranty published; a downloadable 2026 corporate brochure; per-product spec pages; a solar calculator; a live chat widget; and full leadership profiles with a downloadable CMD profile PDF.

N-Type TOPCon Rear Contact at 635-665 W and 24.6% efficiency, with a 12-year product and 30-year linear performance warranty across the range - genuinely competitive specs that most Indian peers cannot match on a public page.

CIN L40106GJ2014PLC081036, incorporated 13 Oct 2014, listed via NSE Emerge 2018. CMD Dr. Chetan Shah. Net debt-to-equity 0.57:1, operating cash flow Rs.200.7 crore, zero-defect metrics claimed, Rs.4,000 crore Gujarat MoU and Vision 2030 covering cells, ingots, wafers and BESS.
findings: 1. The Day-1 domain is dead and the live site is a different address entirely. solexenergy.com fails at the SSL handshake on both the bare host and www - no response at all. The live property is solex.in. This is the address in the lead record, the address in the Google Ads Transparency link, and quite possibly the address on older creatives, directory listings and backlinks. Before another rupee is spent, every ad destination, UTM, QR code and trade-directory entry needs auditing for which domain it actually carries - and solexenergy.com should be restored and 301'd to solex.in so a decade of brand equity is not landing on a connection error.

2. The homepage stat band renders zeros and mangles its own layout. The About Solex band is built from animated counters and on 14 Sep 2026 it reads: '0+ Years of Experience', '14 Successful Projects', 'M+ 0 Modules Shipped within India Across the World', and 'GW 0 PV Modules Manufacturing Capacity'. Three of the four numbers are zero, the unit labels (M+, GW) have separated from their values, and the one figure that does render - 14 - is almost certainly meant to be years of experience but is displayed against 'Successful Projects', which is wrong by a factor of at least fourteen given the company has publicly executed 200+ EPC projects. A visitor from a Rs.8-20 lakh-a-month campaign reads: zero years, zero modules shipped, zero GW capacity, fourteen projects. The truth is a Rs.1,618 crore business with a Rs.4,000 crore order book.

3. The single best number in Indian solar right now is nowhere in the funnel. FY26 revenue up 144.3% to Rs.1,618 crore. Q4 up 247.6%. PAT up 132.7% to Rs.98.3 crore. Order book over Rs.4,000 crore. FY27 guidance of Rs.2,600 crore revenue and Rs.156-208 crore PAT. Net debt-to-equity of 0.57:1. For a C&I buyer signing a 25-year warranty, the single biggest unspoken fear is whether the manufacturer will still exist to honour it - and audited, exchange-filed, triple-digit growth is the most powerful possible answer to that fear. It appears on the investor page and in press releases, and in none of the marketing.

4. The Instagram feed is selling the wrong thing to the wrong people. The site embeds a live Instagram feed, and the most recent posts on 14 Sep 2026 are: two 80s-nostalgia trend reels ('Apparently, the 80s are back'), a Janmashtami greeting, a Teacher's Day post, a CMD birthday tribute, and an office-prank reel ('they weren't very am(o)used'). The genuinely valuable posts - a Rs.74.77 crore order win, the Tapi-R TOPCon performance explainer, the Industry 4.0 manufacturing film - are outnumbered by filler. For a company whose buyers are EPC procurement heads, facility managers and distributors, this is a brand-awareness feed pointed at an audience that does not buy on brand awareness. The Day-1 leak reads 'no LinkedIn ABM layer while running broad Meta'; this is what that looks like in practice.

5. Excellent product specs are published with no path to purchase or quote. The six Tapi series pages carry exactly what a specifier wants - wattage bands, module efficiency to two decimals, half-cut cell configuration, 12-year product and 30-year linear performance warranties. Then the journey stops. There is no RFQ or bulk-quote form, no MOQ, no lead time, no distributor or channel-partner application, no per-product datasheet download alongside each series, and no dealer locator. The corporate brochure is the only downloadable asset. A procurement head who has decided on Tapi RC at 24.6% efficiency has no way to ask for a price on 2 MW of it.

6. No PM Surya Ghar content, and a rooftop app nobody is told about. There is no subsidy page, no slab table (Rs.30,000 / Rs.60,000 / Rs.78,000), no DCR or ALMM explainer for residential buyers - despite the site explicitly claiming residential as a served segment and despite ALMM certification being one of the CMD's stated competitive advantages. Solex also publishes a 'Solex Surya Rooftop' app on both the App Store and Google Play, which is not surfaced anywhere on the homepage. A rooftop app plus ALMM-certified modules plus a solar calculator is a complete residential proposition with no page to sell it.

7. Attribution and routing are thin for a business of this size. With a Lead Form objective and no on-site conversion architecture, there are no mid-funnel signals to optimise against - no datasheet download, no calculator completion, no brochure download, no RFQ start, no product-series view. The chat widget is generic ('Opens Chat') with no stated response time and no WhatsApp. There is also a naming inconsistency across every channel: the brand advertises as Solex Energy, the site is solex.in, the Day-1 record says solexenergy.com, and every social handle is solexenergyin - four variants for one company, which fragments branded search and makes attribution reporting unreliable.
wins: 48 hours - fix the domain and the zeros

Restore solexenergy.com and 301 it to solex.in, then audit every creative destination, UTM and directory listing for the dead address. Repair or hard-code the four homepage counters so they read the real figures - and fix the label mismatch so '14' sits against Years of Experience while Successful Projects reads 200+, not 14. Put FY26 revenue of Rs.1,618 crore and the Rs.4,000 crore order book on the homepage as static text.
7 days - build the quote path and the subsidy page

Add an RFQ form to every Tapi product page capturing capacity required, timeline and segment, plus MOQ and indicative lead time. Publish a per-series datasheet download next to each module. Launch a distributor and channel-partner application. Separately, ship one PM Surya Ghar page with the correct slabs, an ALMM and DCR explainer, and a link to the Solex Surya Rooftop app - which is live on both app stores and currently invisible on the site.
14 days - move the B2B budget to ABM and rebuild the creative around audited numbers

Split the spend. Run a LinkedIn ABM layer against EPC firms, developers, distributors and facility heads using the numbers that actually close C&I deals: 144.3% revenue growth to Rs.1,618 crore, Rs.4,000 crore order book, 200+ projects, 24.6% module efficiency, 12-year product and 30-year performance warranty, ALMM certification, 0.57:1 net debt-to-equity. Keep Meta for the residential and rooftop-app track only. Cut the nostalgia memes from the embedded feed and lead it with the Rs.74.77 crore order win and the Industry 4.0 film. Fire distinct events for RFQ-start, datasheet-download, calculator-complete and brochure-download.
